jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Care Project & SRS Coordinator who will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of customer projects from quotation through delivery. Acting as the link between multiple internal stakeholders, this person will help drive operational excellence while ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

 
Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.
The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

 

Omschrijving

 

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
• Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
• Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
• Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.
 

 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

Our client is looking for a Customer Training & Development Specialist to design, deliver and continuously improve learning initiatives within a customer-facing environment. This role combines training delivery, coaching and learning programme development to support employee growth and operational excellence.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a globally recognised industrial organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, operational excellence and customer-centricity. With an international footprint and a collaborative culture, the company invests heavily in employee development and continuous learning.
Employees benefit from a dynamic working environment where knowledge sharing, professional growth and teamwork are highly valued, creating opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

 

Omschrijving

• Partner with management to identify training needs and develop tailored learning solutions.
• Design, create and continuously improve training materials, manuals, guides and digital learning content.
• Deliver engaging training sessions for both new hires and existing employees.
• Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements where needed.
• Maintain training records and monitor employee learning progress.
• Provide individual coaching and ongoing support to customer service professionals.
• Support the implementation of learning and development initiatives across the organisation.
• Research and introduce modern training methodologies and best practices.
• Contribute to various projects related to employee development and organisational learning.
• Travel occasionally to other company sites to facilitate training sessions.
 

• Master's degree in Business, Education, Human Resources or a related field.
• Previous experience as a Trainer, Learning & Development Specialist, Facilitator or similar role.
• Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
• Proven ability to adapt training approaches to different audiences and topics.
• Experience developing learning content and training programmes.
• Familiarity with e-learning platforms and digital learning tools is an advantage.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and engage others.
• Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative environment.
• Fluent in English.
• Willingness to travel occasionally when required

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

Client Details

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Description

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.

 

What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication
 

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

 

Description

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.

 

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

European association in Brussels

• Coordinate internal and external meetings, ensuring all logistics are handled.

As a Customer Experience Representative, you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of B2B customers and play a key role in delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance teams, you will ensure smooth order processing while proactively supporting commercial activities and continuous improvement initiatives.

Client Details

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. To support its continued growth and customer-centric strategy, the company is looking for a Customer Experience Representative to strengthen its EMEA Sales & Operations team.

Description

As a Customer Experience Representative, you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of B2B customers and play a key role in delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance teams, you will ensure smooth order processing while proactively supporting commercial activities and continuous improvement initiatives.

 

Customer Relationship Management

• Manage and follow up a dedicated portfolio of customers across the EMEA region.
• Act as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and service-related matters.
• Build strong customer relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Handle customer claims, returns and complaints professionally and efficiently.
• Gather relevant customer and market feedback and share insights internally.
Order Management & Sales Support

• Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
• Follow up on orders, backorders and delivery schedules.
• Prepare and follow up quotations in collaboration with the Account Managers.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding pricing, lead times and product availability.
• Support the sales pipeline and contribute to achieving business targets.
• Monitor service performance and customer agreements.
Process Improvement & Operations

• Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with logistics and operations teams to optimize transport, packaging and order flows.
• Contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.
Financial Follow-up

• Support the monitoring of outstanding customer payments.
• Collaborate with finance teams regarding credit limits, payment conditions and invoice-related matters.
 

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or Inside Sales.
• Experience within an international B2B environment is a strong plus.
• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP is an advantage).
• Fluent Dutch and English
• Proactive and able to work autonomously.

• International Automotive Company with office Brussels and Antwerp
• French Speaking environment
Client Details

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.
Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.

What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Projects Lead - Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About Us
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The Role
As Business Operations Associate your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs. 

You will often get a question with little more than a goal attached. We trust you to figure out the rest: to structure the problem yourself and to deliver work of a high standard.
 

What You'll Do
Your main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:
 
 

• Take full ownership of company-wide projects, from scoping and planning to execution and follow-up. 

• Conduct market research and analyses, for example on new markets, crops, competitors or customer 

• segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 

• Set up and follow up on our company OKRs together with management and team leads. 

• Handle confidential information, such as financial, strategic and personnel matters, with discretion.  

As Zymofix grows, new projects will land on your desk.

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in Bioscience Engineering (bio-ingenieur). 

• You are mature and discreet, and you know how to handle confidential information. 

• You set a high standard for the work you deliver: well thought out, structured and well presented. 

• You need few instructions to deliver a strong result. You structure a problem yourself, ask the right questions and take it from there. 

• You enjoy project work and are comfortable juggling several projects at once. 

• You have strong analytical skills and can turn research and data into clear, actionable conclusions. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• A first work experience, for example in consulting or a startup environment, is a plus.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

As a Technician Electric Motors, you are responsible for the complete process of disassembly, repair, overhaul and testing of industrial motors and drives.

Your daily tasks include:

• Performing electrical tests on motors and checking windings

• Disassembling electric motors, gearboxes, pumps and other electrically driven machines

• Inspecting components for wear and defects

• Cleaning and reassembling parts according to technical guidelines

• Performing test runs and electrical measurements after repair

• Working on bearings, seals, gears and shafts

• Contributing to problem-solving and technical improvements

• Ensuring every machine is delivered in perfect technical condition

• Working mainly in the workshop, with occasional on-site customer interventions

Essential:

• Technical education in mechanics, electromechanics or machine tools

• Good mechanical and electrical knowledge

• Understanding of basic electrical principles

• Accurate, detail-oriented work style

• Practical mindset and willingness to get hands dirty

• Safety-conscious approach to tools and machines

• Category B driving license

• English language skills

Advantageous:

• Experience disassembling and assembling machines

• Knowledge of electric motors, gearboxes or industrial machinery

• Logical problem-solving abilities

Our customer is looking for an Administrator to join the Packaging Department. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring suppliers to ensure their packaging complies with the European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Monitoring suppliers' compliance with PPWR requirements and ensuring project deadlines are achieved.
 
• Organizing and facilitating online meetings with suppliers.
 
• Advising suppliers on packaging types, responsibilities, and compliance expectations.
 
• Explaining regulatory requirements and guiding suppliers through implementation plans.
 
• Coordinating action plans and establishing clear timelines and milestones.
 
• Following up on corrective actions and tracking supplier progress.
 
• Preparing weekly compliance and progress reports for management.
 
• Escalating risks, concerns, and non-compliance issues when necessary.
 
• Conducting compliance checks and audits on packaging and manufacturer labels within warehouse operations.
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling activities comply with PPWR regulations and internal quality standards.
 
• Contributing to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain environment. 

Who are we looking for? 
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.
 
• Experience in logistics, compliance, supply chain administration, or project coordination is an asset.
 
• Knowledge of sustainable packaging solutions is considered a strong plus. 
 

 
• Fluent in English.
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Access and/or Power BI.
 
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
 
• Detail-oriented, accurate, and reliable.
 
• Capable of working independently while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues.
 
• Proactive mindset with strong follow-up skills, analytic, team-oriented, positive, handson.

jobs.occupation: Jet Engin Inspector | Zaventem | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:

• You are stress-resistant and take responsibility 
 
• You are flexible can adapt to changing working conditions. 
 
• As an Inspector quality and safety are your priorities. 
 
• You are proactive and can take decisions in urgent situations. 
 
• You have a very good knowledge of technical English, with some knowledge of Dutch or French and you are willing to improve your skills. 
 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts (from 6am to 2pm, and from 2pm to 10pm). 
 
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and supporting your colleagues.

Requirements: 
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU passport or valid work and residence permit). 

Visa or permit assistance is not provided.
